{{Quote|Outliers. We have former Imperials working throughout every level of the New Republic government and they've all taken oaths of loyalty.|Rodrigo to the [[Hera Syndulla]]|<ref name="Part Three" />}}
[[Senator]] '''Rodrigo''' was a [[New Republic]] legislator active during the [[New Republic Era]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[quest to find Ezra Bridger]].<ref name="Part Three" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rodrigo first appeared via a hologram in "[[Part Three: Time to Fly]]",<ref name="Part Three" /> the third episode of the live-action [[Star Wars: Ahsoka|''Ahsoka'' television series]] which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[August 29]], [[2023]].<ref name="Release">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The character was portrayed by actor [[Jacqueline Antaramian]].<ref name="Part Three" />
